aspects.title: Moon — Jupiter (120° / 60°)
aspects.description: A surge of optimism, generosity and inner calm. Luck favors large-scale undertakings, legal matters, travel and conversation.

aspects.title: Moon — Venus (120° / 60°)
aspects.description: Harmony of feeling, heightened charm and a pull toward beauty. An excellent time for romance, creativity, pleasant purchases and rest.

aspects.title: Moon — Mercury (120° / 60°)
aspects.description: Excellent understanding between emotion and logic. Thoughts flow easily, and any negotiation, study or work with information goes well.

aspects.title: Moon — Sun (120° / 60°)
aspects.description: Inner agreement with yourself, a surge of strength and harmony in relationships with the opposite sex and with authority figures.

aspects.title: Moon — Saturn (120° / 60°)
aspects.description: Emotional composure, reliability and practicality. A good time for putting things in order, handling real estate matters and fulfilling obligations.

aspects.title: Moon — Saturn (90° / 180°)
aspects.description: A sense of loneliness, an emotional slump, melancholy and bureaucratic obstacles. Patience, discipline and letting go of haste are needed.

aspects.title: Moon — Mars (90° / 180° / 0° Conjunction)
aspects.description: A short temper, irritability and a sharp surge of impulsive energy. The risk of conflicts or injuries rises. It is best to channel the energy into sports.

aspects.title: Moon — Pluto (90° / 180°)
aspects.description: Inner tension, a tendency toward drama, jealousy and attempts to control everything around you. Avoid confrontational situations.

aspects.title: Moon — Venus (90° / 180°)
aspects.description: Emotional moodiness, touchiness and a tendency to overindulge (especially in food and spending). It is best not to settle financial matters now.

aspects.title: Moon — Mercury (90° / 180°)
aspects.description: Mental bustle, with emotions winning out over reason. Misunderstandings in conversation and mistakes in paperwork are possible.

aspects.title: Moon — Uranus (60° / 120° / Conjunction)
aspects.description: Sudden flashes of insight, a longing for freedom and unconventional solutions. A wonderful period for brainstorming, working with IT and pleasant surprises.

aspects.title: Moon — Neptune (60° / 120°)
aspects.description: Sharpened intuition, deep empathy and immersion in creativity, music and meditative practice. A gentle dissolving of the boundaries of reality.

aspects.title: Moon — Pluto (60° / 120°)
aspects.description: A powerful psychological transformation, the ability to see the essence of hidden processes and to free yourself from inner fears.
